_source: Deterministic parse of raw Telair PBX CSV exports (ExportCallRecords, InboundCalls_Detailed, CallQueue_Detailed per queue) via scripts/parse_call_logs.py, replacing PDF text-extraction for this section per the Phase 3 raw-source ingestion plan. Verified field-for-field against the official YourGP_CallLogs_DataProcessor_Final_v6 workbook (the Excel/Power-Query/VBA tool that actually produces this report), which the user shared on 2026-10-07 — every figure below was cross-checked against that workbook's own KPI_Calculations/InboundQueueSummary/InboundStaffSummary/OutboundStaffSummary/Outbound_10Day_Trend sheets, not just the rendered PDF.
_summaryVsGrandTotalNote: summary (totalInbound 368, accepted 331, missed 37) matches the official workbook's KPI_Calculations and PDF cover exactly. grandTotal (330 accepted) is 1 short of summary's 331: the official workbook's own InboundQueueSummary reports 329 (2 short) — 2 of the 331 accepted calls aren't attributable to any of the 4 named queues at all (a different reception line, confirmed in the official workbook's own Cleaned_Call_Records sheet), which this project has no field for and doesn't track per-queue. The remaining 1-call gap (330 vs the official 329) is a residual in this script's own Appointments count that doesn't fully resolve against the official workbook's row-level classification despite matching its row count exactly post-dedup (228 unique rows both ways) — recorded verbatim rather than chased further for the sake of one call.
_tenDayTrendNote: accepted/missed/answerRatePct/overallAvgWaitSec all chain-matched 2026-10-02's own committed trend exactly at positions 0-8, position 9 confirmed against the official workbook and the PDF cover — high confidence, zero divergence.
_queuesNote: Per-queue accepted/missed/avgWaitSec chain-matched 2026-10-02's own committed data exactly at positions 0-8, sourced from the raw CallQueue_Detailed exports (deduplicated by CallGUID — the raw export contained one literal duplicate row). Appointments position 9 (208) carries the same 1-call residual noted above (official: 207).
_patientServiceKpiNote: longestWaitingTimeSec/longestWaitingAt use UserTimeToAnswer (time until the specific agent who answered actually engaged), not CallTimeToAnswer (time in the queue before being routed) — confirmed against the official workbook's KPI_Calculations sheet, whose 'Longest Waiting Time' value and timestamp match a call's UserTimeToAnswer exactly. An earlier version of this file used CallTimeToAnswer instead and got 613 sec/12:39 PM/Ambrosie Brassil — that was this project's own bug, not a discrepancy with the PDF; corrected here to 534 sec/12:42 PM/Samantha Cooper, matching the official workbook and the PDF exactly.
_inboundByStaffNote: Full table from InboundCalls_Detailed (deduplicated by CallGUID). Sums to 331, matching the cover pie and the official workbook's InboundStaffSummary exactly, name-for-name and call-for-call.

outboundOtherExtensions.name: RM5 Dr Chi So / Dr Mel Deery
RM1 Dr Elizabeth Muller / Dr Anna Colwell

_outboundNote: outboundByStaff (174 calls, matching the PDF's own 'Total Outbound Calls = 174' caption) now matches the official workbook's OutboundStaffSummary table exactly, name-for-name and call-for-call, after two fixes: the known-staff roster now starts from the official workbook's own Source_Table sheet (the exact reception roster it uses) rather than only names seen in this project's own history, and Jasmina Sodolovic (an email/admin staff member who isn't reception, but had been pulled in by an earlier version of this script's now-removed Cloop-email-based roster heuristic) is explicitly excluded. outboundOtherExtensionsTotal (131, everyone else — doctors' rooms, admin extensions, and 11 calls with no attributed extension at all) plus outboundByStaff (174) now sums to 305, matching the official workbook's Outbound_10Day_Trend sheet exactly — see outboundTenDayTrend's own note below for what that number actually tracks.
_outboundTenDayTrendNote: FLAG FOR USER: this field tracks a DIFFERENT, larger metric than summary.totalOutbound/outboundByStaff above (174) — it's every outbound call from every extension in the building (reception, doctors' rooms, everyone), confirmed by directly matching the official workbook's own Outbound_10Day_Trend sheet (a 10-day rolling history, read in full from the file the user shared). Positions 0-8 here are that sheet's own verified values for 22 Sep - 2 Oct, NOT the carried-forward reception-only figures this project committed for those same dates historically (152, 170, 115, 123, 145, 122, 146, 94, 108) — this project had been dismissing this exact chart's numbers as unreliable PDF-extraction noise since at least 2026-10-02's own file, when they were actually a legitimate, different, and apparently fully trustworthy metric the whole time. This means every historical date's own outboundTenDayTrend.totals field (not just the labels/positions 0-8 overridden here) is very likely wrong in the same way — this file corrects today's entry using verified source data, but nothing upstream of today has been touched. Please let me know if you'd like those historical dates corrected too.
